title: SGFirePlanner Results Payload v2
description: Canonical schema for the planner results payload sent from the web planner to the companion app.

computed_at_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the result was computed.

input_signature.description: Optional hash of the input parameters used to produce this result.

scenario_id.description: Identifier of the companion scenario that produced this result.

scenario_name.description: Human-readable name of the companion scenario.

n_simulations.description: Number of Monte Carlo simulations run.

cached.description: Whether the result was served from cache.

horizon_years.description: Number of years from retirement to life expectancy.

target_fire_age.description: Target FIRE (retirement) age from the plan inputs.

projected_fire_age_p50.description: Median projected age at which FIRE is achieved.

annual_expenses_target_real.description: Annual expenses target in today's dollars.

required_portfolio.description: Required portfolio size to sustain withdrawals.

required_portfolio_basis.description: Which safe withdrawal rate confidence level was used to derive required_portfolio.

required_savings_rate.description: Fraction of income that must be saved annually to reach required_portfolio by target_fire_age. Can be negative if already on track.

p_success.description: Probability of plan success (portfolio lasting through retirement).

fail_prob_0_5y.description: Probability of plan failure in years 0-5 of retirement.

fail_prob_6_10y.description: Probability of plan failure in years 6-10 of retirement.

portfolio_at_fire_p50.description: Median portfolio value at FIRE age.

allocation_weights.description: Breakdown of portfolio allocation weights by asset class.
